## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `CreateAProject`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `create-a-project`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **CreateAProject**.

## Step 2: Add an integration

1. Select **Integration (Default)** as the **Type** — *A deployable unit that can be built, tested, and deployed.*
2. <!-- manual: Enter an Integration Name (defaults to Untitled). -->
3. <!-- manual: Optionally expand Advanced Configurations to set Ballerina package details: -->
4. Select **Add Integration**.

## Step 3: Add a library

1. Select **Library** as the **Type** — *Shared logic and utilities that can be reused across multiple integrations.*
2. <!-- manual: Enter a Library Name (defaults to Untitled). -->
3. <!-- manual: Optionally expand Advanced Configurations to set the same Ballerina package fields as above. Organization Name is inherited from the parent project. -->
4. Select **Add Library**.
